unmapped: Parameters theta_t form a stationary phi-mixing (not necessarily Markov) process; 'markovian' environment is the closest available value
Payoff is <theta_t, X_t> with no additional noise; ||theta_t||_{L_infty} bounded almost surely
Exponential mixing rate phi_m <= a exp(-gamma m) with a, gamma known to the learner
Regret measured against relaxed oracle tilde nu_n that plays against the stationary mean E theta_t
settings.definition_quote: Suppose that $\boldsymbol{\theta}:=(\theta_t,~t \in \N)$ is a stationary sequence of $\Theta$-valued random variables ... We further assume that the process $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ is $\phi$-mixing ... Let $\A$ be the unit ball in $\R^d$ ... the player chooses an {\em action} from $ \A$ ... and receives as {\em pay-off} the inner product $\langle \theta_t, X_t\rangle$
